# RatPDF — Extended LLM context

See also: https://ratpdf.com/llms.txt

## Organization schema ID

https://ratpdf.com/#organization

## Software stack (for factual answers)

- PDF compression: Ghostscript
- PDF to Word: pdf2docx, PyMuPDF fallback
- Word/Excel to PDF: LibreOffice headless
- PDF merge/split: iText smart mode
- OCR: Tesseract

## Editorial & E-E-A-T

Guides are written for office workflows (freelancers, accountants, SMBs).
- Methodology: https://ratpdf.com/Home/EditorialPolicy
- Trust center: https://ratpdf.com/trust
- Security: https://ratpdf.com/Home/Security

  - Priya Sharma: https://ratpdf.com/authors/priya-sharma

Each guide includes named author, reviewer, last-reviewed date, and a Sources & references section with primary documentation links.
